description: Rega de espaços verdes do município is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CMPEAE - Águas e Energia do Porto. Reading data from counters associated with green spaces. The records were generated by telemetry equipment, according to the availability of the data, that is, not every month there is data recorded. Coverage: Porto. The portal shows the English title as "Watering of green spaces of the municipality" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CMPEAE - Águas e Energia do Porto. Its keywords include telemetria, rega-espacos-verdes, agua. The listing shows 3 download or service links in URL, CSV. The listing shows 2026-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
